text: We've had ants coming in through the kitchen window for about a week now. We wipe the bench down every night but they're back in the morning, all over the sugar and the bread. My husband and I are both in our eighties and can't really get down on the floor to spray along the skirting. Could someone come and treat the house when they're next around?

Tenant says no water has come out of any tap or the toilet cistern since yesterday morning. He is an elderly man who lives alone and can't walk far, so he cannot carry water from the neighbours. Dirt road in is still open but may close once the rain starts.

Tenant reports a strong smell of gas in the kitchen even with all the stove knobs turned off, and the flame jumped out the side of the burner when she lit it this morning. She is pregnant and has taken the family outside away from the house. Road in is dirt and the crew base is a long way off.

The bathroom basin tap has been dripping for a couple of weeks and now it won't stop even when I turn it hard. It's not flooding anything, just wasting water and leaving a rusty stain in the sink. I'm seven months pregnant and we've got a toddler, so I'd like it fixed before the baby comes. I know the road gets cut when the wet comes, so sooner might be better.

Two roof sheets over the back bedroom have come loose and they bang every time the wind picks up at night. There's a small brown mark on the ceiling under them but nothing dripping yet. There's eleven of us in this three-bedroom house, including my old mum and a little baby, so the noise keeps everyone awake. Please send someone before the wet season shuts the road.
No water in my house since Sunday night, taps all dry and the toilet won't fill. I been getting water from my cousin place but that not good. Can you send plumber out, the road still ok for now.
Back screen door hinge snapped, door drags on the ground but still locks. Old nan here with my two grandkids, youngest only four, keeps pinching his fingers in it.
Cockroaches in the kitchen and bathroom cupboards, getting worse. My partner has a long-term condition and is in a wheelchair, can't reach down to clean them out.
Kitchen sink and laundry tub both blocked solid, water just sits there, can't wash dishes or clothes. One of us is on dialysis three days a week and we need to keep things clean.
Light in our bedroom not working no more. We put new globe in already and still nothing, the other lights all fine. My partner having our first baby next month so we want it fixed before then.

Last night one of the power points in the kitchen started sparking and smoking as soon as we plugged the kettle in. There's a black burn mark on the wall around it and it still smells like burnt plastic. We've turned the power off at the box but now we've got nothing running. Please get an electrician out today.

A pipe burst under the kitchen sink this morning and water poured out across the floor into the lounge and bedrooms. We had to turn the water off at the meter, so now there's no water for drinking, the toilet or washing. There are eleven of us in the house, including my elderly father and a baby, and it's way too crowded to be without water. The floor is still soaked and the carpet is squelching.

Wires is hanging out of the wall in the lounge where the power point fell off, and they spark when you touch near it. Seven of us living here, too many people in the house, we can't keep everyone away from that wall. Please come quick before somebody get hurt.
No power in the whole house since last night, nothing sparking, just dead. Fridge off and food going bad.

Back sliding door is jammed shut and won't open at all, we been pushing it for days. Front door still lock fine but that back door is the only way to get breeze through. House got tin roof and no trees, it's like an oven inside in this heat.
Clothesline in the backyard broke, one of the arms come right off and the line all slack now. Still can hang a few things but not much. Can somebody come fix it when they got time.

Tenant reports the air conditioner stopped working completely two days ago and there is no other cooling in the house. Unit makes no noise when switched on and there is no smell or smoke from it. Tenant asks for a technician to attend.

The tap on the outside wall by the laundry has been leaking slowly for about a month. It doesn't turn off all the way and there's a muddy patch underneath it now. My partner has severe asthma, so we'd prefer someone sorts it before it gets worse. I know crews only come over on the barge or plane, so whenever the next one's here is fine.

Hot water taking ages to come through now, have to run the shower long time before it warm. Still get hot water but the pipe on the side of the tank dripping all day. Seven of us in this house with five kids, too crowded, and the baby only under one so we need it working good.
Rats all through the kitchen, chewing into food and droppings on the benches every morning. Can't cook or keep any food in there.

Tenant says the front door was kicked in overnight and the frame is split, so the door won't shut or lock at all and the back door lock is broken too. She reports eight people living in the three-bedroom house, including two babies, and they can't secure the house tonight. Barge isn't due for a while so she's asking if someone can fly out.

The aircon in the lounge still blowing cold but it make a loud rattling noise and water drip down the wall under it. My grandfather is old and he got a heart problem, he sit in that room most of the day because it's real hot outside now. Two grandkids and me here too. Can someone look at it next time the crew come over on the plane.

Our only toilet stopped flushing yesterday morning and the water just sits in the bowl and goes down very slow. We tried the plunger but it made no difference, and nothing has come up anywhere. We are both in our eighties and walking over to a neighbour's toilet is hard for us. We know the crew has to come on the plane or barge but we would like it fixed as soon as they can.
Gutter at the back hanging loose at one end. No leaks inside, just want it fixed before it gets worse.

Toilet is blocked since two days, it won't flush and we got no other toilet in the house. My partner got diabetes and need the toilet a lot, and we got a little one only two years old. Nothing coming out on the floor but we can't use it. Road still open for now but the rain coming.

We woke up this morning and there was no water coming out of any tap in the house. The neighbours have water so it seems to be just our place. Our adult son has a disability and needs daily care, so we need water for washing him and for the toilet. The road is still open at the moment but we're worried it could close if the wet comes early.
Back left hotplate on the stove not heating. Others all fine.
Bathroom tap dripping all the time, won't turn off properly. One of us on dialysis three days a week, just want it sorted when the crew's out.
Storm tore a roof sheet loose over the kids' room, rain drips in and the room can't be used. House is already like an oven by the afternoon with the sun coming through.
Hot water still working but it take a long time to get hot, longer than before. Tank make a ticking noise too. Not a big hurry, just when the crew coming this way.
Tenant reports the screen door at the back no longer latches and swings open in the wind. The main back door still locks fine. Asks for the latch to be replaced when someone is next in the area.
Toilet not flushing since last night, the water just stay in the bowl. It's the only toilet I got. Nothing come up on the floor, but I can't use it at all.
Kitchen tap snapped off at the base, water running nonstop into the sink and can't turn it off. I'm getting on in years and minding my two grandkids, youngest only four.

Tenant says the kitchen sink and laundry tub have stopped draining and dirty water is sitting in both, so she can't wash dishes or clothes. The toilet is still working and nothing has come up inside the house. She is pregnant and lives with her mother and two siblings, and knows the crew will need to come on the barge or plane.

We've had cockroaches in the kitchen for a few weeks now and they're getting worse at night. We've tried the spray from the store but they keep coming back from behind the cupboards. There's a relative staying with us who's just had surgery and is resting up, so we'd like it cleaned up. Happy to wait for the next time the crew flies in.

Power point in the kitchen is sparking and black around it, and there's a burning smell. I switch it off at the box but I'm scared to turn the power back on. Need someone come quick, I know it's a plane to get here.

Tenant says the outside garden tap leaks a steady trickle and the ground around it has gone muddy. The elderly couple are caring for three grandchildren under six and mention the kids like playing near it. They are happy for it to be fixed when the barge brings the next crew.

Half the house got no power since this morning, the kitchen and the lounge. Fridge is off and food going bad. Nothing burning or sparking, just dead. My grandfather is old and got heart trouble, he can't be running back and forth to the neighbours.

The aircon remote not working anymore, the unit still go when we push the button on the wall but it's hard for my grandfather to reach. He is old and got a heart condition. Can you send a new remote or fix it.

Tenant reports the power went off in the back half of the house after last night's storm, so the fridge and the kids' bedrooms have no electricity, though nothing is sparking or smelling. The elderly couple are looking after three grandchildren under six. She notes the road is still open but rain is coming and it may close.

Tenant says a pipe under the house is leaking steadily and the taps inside are down to a trickle, so it takes ages to fill a bucket for the six of them. She reports one adult in the house has kidney disease and needs to keep drinking and washing properly. Road is still open for now but she is worried it will close once the rains come.
Toilet backed up, sewage coming up the shower drain and all over the bathroom floor. Newborn baby in the house.

Hot water system not working since three days now, only cold coming out. We got nine people living in this house and two little ones under five, they need warm bath. Hard to keep everybody clean with cold water only. Road still open but please send someone before the wet.

The fridge that came with the house stopped working two nights ago and now it won't cool at all. I'm seven months pregnant and I've got a toddler, and we can't keep milk or meat cold so we keep throwing food out. Fresh food only comes in on the barge so we can't just buy more every day. Can someone come out on the next plane to fix it or swap it?

After the storm last week a length of guttering at the back pulled away from the roof and now water pours down the wall whenever it rains. Nothing is coming inside, it just runs down past the back step. I look after my elderly mum who lives here with me and I'd like it sorted before it gets any worse. No rush, just please put it on the list.
Shower tap is broke, the handle just spinning round and no water come out the shower at all. We been washing at the laundry sink for two days now. Just me and my partner living here.

Tenant reports the key snapped off inside the front door lock, so the family can only get in and out through the back door, which still locks. She has newborn twins and a four-year-old and says getting the pram in and out the back is very hard. She asks for a crew before the wet season closes the road.

Yesterday the front screen door came off its top hinge and now it's hanging, and the main door behind it won't close properly unless you lift it. We can still lock it but it takes two of us to line it up. There's eleven of us in three bedrooms, including my nan and a baby, so that door gets used all day and it's getting worse every time.

Tenant says one hotplate on the electric stove will not turn off and is glowing red even with the knob at off, and there is a burning smell coming from behind the stove. She reports they are both retired, the house faces west with fans only, and it is already extremely hot inside by the afternoon with the hotplate making it worse.
Back left hotplate on the stove not heating, other three fine. Oven light's gone too.

Early this morning a pipe burst under the bathroom sink and water is spraying everywhere. It's running down the hallway into the bedrooms and I can't find the tap to shut it off. I look after my elderly dad who lives here and I'm trying to keep him out of the wet. I know the crew has to fly in but we need someone to stop it.
No water from any tap since yesterday, can't flush or wash. House like an oven by the afternoon.
Water pressure gone right down, shower just dribbling and the kettle takes ages to fill. Old fella in my seventies here on my own.

Toilet overflow and the sewage come up through the floor drain into the bathroom and laundry, whole floor dirty. We can't use the toilet or shower now, nowhere to wash. My grandfather he old and got a heart problem, he living here with us. Road still open, please come quick.
Light in the kitchen not working no more, I change the globe already and still nothing. Rest of the house power is fine. Can someone come check it when they got time.

Tenant says the back door lock is jammed and the door won't open from either side, so the family can only use the front door, which still locks. She reports she is pregnant and lives with her mother and two siblings, and they would like it fixed before the wet closes the road.

Tenant reports the hot water system is dripping from the pipe on the side of the tank onto the ground outside; hot water is still working fine inside. The adults in the house do not read or write, so please phone or visit rather than send a letter.
Water pump stopped, nothing coming to the taps or toilet since last night.

Laundry tap leaking a little bit all the time, drip drip, we put a bucket under it. Seven of us living here so that laundry always busy. Water still working, just want it fixed when the crew coming out this way.
Clothesline pole bent right over, can't hang washing on it. One of us on dialysis three days a week so we're out a lot, fix it whenever.
No water coming out of any tap since yesterday. Just me, an old woman, with my two grandkids, little one only four, and the barge not back for a while.

Key snapped off inside the front door lock and now it won't open from outside. I been going in and out the back door, that one still lock okay so the house is safe. Need somebody come fix the front one.
Shower tap spun loose and won't turn off properly, water running nonstop down the drain but not flooding. House gets like an oven by the arvo so we really need the shower working.
Toilet blocked and won't flush at all, nothing coming out onto the floor but we've got no toilet now. Partner's in a wheelchair with an ongoing health condition, can't just go use one somewhere else.
Hot water been gone three days now, only cold coming out the taps. My partner got diabetes and need to keep clean and look after the feet. We got a two year old too who need a warm bath every night.
Front door lock is stuffed, key won't turn so everyone's using the back door, which still locks fine. Twelve of us in the house with family here for the season.

A gutter on the side of the house came loose in the wind last week and is hanging down near the back step. A couple of roof screws are rattling as well, but no water is getting inside. I'm seven months pregnant and we've got a toddler, so I'd like it looked at. The road gets rough out here, so whenever the crew next comes through is fine.
Roof leaking over the bedroom every time it rains, buckets on the floor and we can't sleep in there. Road could close soon with the wet coming.

The shower drain has been slow for about a month now, the water sits around your feet for ages before it goes down. The toilet and everything else is working fine. We've got three kids and the youngest is only eighteen months, so bath time takes forever. I know the crew has to fly in, so the next visit is fine.

Our water stopped yesterday morning when the pipe out to the tank split, and we turned it off so it isn't running everywhere. Now there's nothing in the house to drink, cook or wash with. I'm seven months pregnant with a toddler, so carrying buckets from next door is really hard. The road is still open for now.

Tenant says sewage is coming up through the shower and toilet and spreading across the bathroom floor into the hallway. She reports the family cannot use the toilet or bathroom at all and the smell is through the whole house.
Hinge on the flyscreen door broke, now it drags on the ground. Main door still locks fine, just a full house with the extended family here so it's getting opened all day.

Tenant says the roof over the kitchen started leaking in the last storm and rain is coming in, they have buckets down. He reports the rest of the house is dry and it still locks up. Crew would need to come in by plane or barge.
Cockroaches all through the kitchen cupboards, getting worse. Partner's in a wheelchair with a long-term health condition and can't get down low to clean them out.

Somebody kick in our front door last night and the frame all split, door won't close or lock no more. We got a two year old and my partner have diabetes, the insulin is in the fridge. We can't leave the house open like this another night.

Since the weekend the drain outside where the kitchen sink and the washing machine empty has been blocked. Water won't go down from either, but nothing is overflowing and the toilet still works. I look after my mum, she's in her eighties and lives here with me. Can someone come out this week please.
Tenant says two of the four hotplates on the stove have stopped working, the other two and the oven are fine. She reports the house faces west, has fans only and gets very hot in the afternoons.

Power gone to the kitchen and back rooms since two days, fridge not running. Nothing sparking or burning, it just dead. My partner diabetic and the insulin got to stay cold, and we got a two year old. Road still open but rain coming.
Shower drain completely blocked, water just sits there and won't go down, toilet's still fine. House is boiling by the afternoon too.
Septic's full and the toilet won't flush, nothing's come up inside but we've got no toilet. One of us is in a wheelchair with a long-term condition, and the road might shut soon.

Tenant says no water has come out of any tap since yesterday morning and they can't flush the toilet either. She and her husband are both elderly and are looking after three grandkids under six, so they can't bath the little ones or wash up.

Tenant reports the back screen door has come off its top hinge and drags on the ground when opened; the main door still locks fine. She is pregnant and finds the screen heavy to lift. Officer notes the road in may get cut once the wet sets in.

A few days ago the water pressure dropped right off and now the taps and shower only dribble. There's a pipe leaking steady near the meter outside, the ground around it is soaked. My partner has bad asthma so we need things running properly in the house. I know it's a long drive out on the dirt road, but please send someone before the rain closes it.
Air con dead, won't turn on at all. Got a newborn at home.
Power point in the spare room not working, rest of the house fine.
Tenant says the front door lock has jammed and the key won't turn either way, so she has to come and go through the back door, which still locks properly. Asked for a locksmith to look at it soon.

Our air conditioner stop working three days now, it only blowing warm air. My husband he got diabetes and our little one only two, they both not sleeping good. I know the workers got to come on the plane but please send someone soon as you can.

Tenant reports the shower and laundry drains are blocked and the water sits in the shower base for hours, though the toilet still flushes. He is an old man living on his own and is finding it hard to wash. Officer notes trades would need to fly or come on the barge.
Tenant reports two of the four hotplates on the stove don't heat up; the oven and the other two plates work fine. She is pregnant and would like it looked at when a crew is next around.

Storm took some roof sheets off near the back and now rain come in through the ceiling in one bedroom when it pour. We got buckets under it. My mum she is old and that was her room, she sleeping in the lounge now.
Back gutter hanging off at one end, no leaks inside. Road's still open for now.

Tenant reports the kitchen power point sparked and went black around the edges when the kettle was plugged in, and there was a burning smell. She has turned the power off at the switchboard and is staying out of the kitchen.

Toilet is block two days now, it won't flush and the water just sit there in the bowl. Seven of us living here, three generations, and only the one toilet so we all going to the neighbour. Nothing come out on the floor but we got no toilet to use.

The flyscreen door on the front is broke, the closer thing snapped so it bang open in the wind. Front door still lock ok. My partner have diabetes and we got a two year old, so we home most days and hear it banging all the time.
Hot water system dripping from the valve outside, still getting hot water fine.

Big mob of mice and cockroaches got in the kitchen, chewing through all the food and droppings everywhere on the benches. We can't cook or keep food in there no more. The pest man got to come on the plane I think.
No water at all since this morning, every tap dry, toilet won't fill. Someone on dialysis lives here.
The clothes line out the back it fall over, the pole rusted through at the bottom. Not a big problem but the road get bad when the wet come so maybe fix before that.
The oven door don't close all the way, there's a gap at the top, but oven still get hot and the hotplates working. My wife she got diabetes and we got a two year old so we cook at home every day.
Tenant reports the only toilet is blocked and won't flush; the water rises in the bowl but has not spilled over. She is pregnant and the household has no other toilet to use.
Aircon on the wall started sparking and smoking this arvo, we switched it off at the box. House is baking hot by afternoon and now nothing to cool it.

One power point in the lounge stopped working about a week ago. We tried a different plug and still nothing, but every other point and all the lights are fine. Our son has a disability and needs care every day, so we'd like someone to come and look at it when they can.

Tenant says the flyscreen on the back bedroom window is torn right through and the mozzies are getting in at night. She reports one of the adults in the house of six has kidney disease. Road in is unsealed and can close once the wet starts.

Screen door closer is broke, the door just bang shut all the time now. Front door still lock ok, it only the screen one. My partner got diabetes and we got a little one, two years old. Road out here go bad in the wet so better before then.
Tenant reports the back left hotplate on the stove has stopped heating, the other three and the oven still work. She is pregnant and lives with her mum and two siblings.

The oven door stopped closing properly about a week ago and drops open a bit unless you hold it. The hotplates all still work so we can cook on top. My partner has bad asthma. The road out here gets cut when the wet comes so it'd be good to get it fixed before then.

Tenant says the ceiling fan in the kids' room has started making a loud clicking noise but still spins, and the aircon in the lounge is working fine. She has newborn twins and a four-year-old and says the place gets very hot in the afternoons.

Tenant reports the only toilet in the house is blocked and won't flush at all since yesterday; nothing has come up onto the floor. She says the family has no working toilet now and she is pregnant. Road to the community is dirt and may close when the rain comes.
Front door lock broke this morning, key won't turn no more so we can't open it from in or out. We using the back door for now and it still lock. Only got the one way in and out the house now.
Tenant says the aircon stopped working altogether two days ago and there is no other cooling in the unit. He is an older man who lives alone and doesn't get around easily.

The lock on our front door jammed on Sunday night and now the door won't open at all. Everyone has to go in and out the back, which still locks. There's eleven of us in three bedrooms, including my old nan and a baby, so it's a lot of people using one door. Can someone come and fix it this week?

The light in the laundry has been flickering for about a fortnight and now it only comes on sometimes. All the power points and the other lights are working fine. Our son has a disability and we look after him every day. The road gets cut in the wet so we'd like it done before then.

Tenant says a kitchen cupboard door has come off its hinge and two of the drawers won't slide out properly anymore. She is pregnant and asked for someone to come when the crew is next out, before the road closes.

The handle on the kids' bedroom door came off in my hand last week and now the door won't latch. The front and back doors are fine and lock properly. We've got three kids under ten and the youngest is eighteen months. The road gets rough later in the year so whenever you can get out here.

Tenant reports the shower is draining slowly and water sits around their feet for a few minutes before it goes; the toilet and sinks are fine. He says the house faces west, they only have fans and it gets very hot inside. Crew would need to come over by barge or plane.

Power gone off in the kitchen and two bedroom since last night, fridge not going. Switch in the box keep flicking down when we push it up. No smoke or burning, just no power there. Nine of us living here, two little ones under five.
Tenant says the rotary clothesline in the backyard has come loose at the base and is leaning over. He moved in last month and noticed it straight away.

We've had no water out of any tap or the shower since yesterday morning. Nothing is leaking that we can see, it just stopped. I'm seven months pregnant and we have a toddler, so we're carrying buckets from next door. The road is still open but it gets bad when the rain starts.
Outside light by the back door not working. Put a new globe in, still nothing.
Whole house got no power since this morning, nothing in any room. Neighbours still got their power so it just ours. No burning smell or nothing, it just dead. Road still ok to drive in for now.

Tenant says the kitchen tap has been dripping for a couple of weeks and won't turn off all the way, but the water is still running fine everywhere else. She mentions one of the adults in the house has kidney disease and they would like it fixed before the wet, in case the road closes.
Tenant reports one of the four hotplates on the stove has stopped heating up; the other three and the oven still work. He moved in last month and says it was like that when he arrived.

The outside tap by the back steps leaking all the time, making a big mud patch. Inside water still working okay. Our house get really hot with the tin roof and no trees around, so we use that tap a lot but it won't turn off proper.

Since yesterday morning there has been no water coming out of any tap in the house. The toilet won't flush and the shower is dry as well. I checked with next door and theirs is working, so it is just our place. Me and my two teenagers have been carrying water over in buckets.

Key broke off inside the front door lock yesterday and now that door won't open at all. Only way in and out is the back door with the steep steps. My mum is old, she can't hardly get down them steps. House still lock up okay but we need the front door working again.

Our hot water system stopped working three days ago and we have only had cold water since then. My partner has severe asthma, so we would like it looked at soon. We know the crew has to come over on the barge or by plane, so please let us know when someone can get out here.

The air conditioner in the lounge room started making a loud rattling noise last week. It still cools the house fine, it's just noisy and keeps waking our toddler at nap time. I'm seven months pregnant so I'd like it sorted before it gets worse. We know someone will have to fly in or come on the barge.

Our air conditioner stopped working completely two days ago and now the house stays hot and stuffy day and night. The fans are not keeping up. We have a relative staying with us who is recovering from surgery. I understand the tradies need to come by barge or plane but we really need someone soon.

Half the power points in the house stopped working yesterday afternoon, including the fridge and the kitchen ones. Nothing is burning or smelling and the switchboard looks normal, there is just no power to that side. We have a family member staying with us who is getting over an operation. We know the crew comes by barge or plane but we can't keep food cold.

Bathroom basin draining real slow, water sitting there long time before it go down. Toilet and shower still all good. Grandad live with us, he old and got heart trouble, so we like it fixed when someone free.
Power point in kitchen sparking and smoking, black marks up the wall. Someone here on dialysis three days a week, need it made safe today, road still open.

The handle on the back bedroom door came off in my hand on the weekend. The door still shuts but you have to push it with your shoulder. A relative recovering from surgery is staying with us and sleeping in that room. It's not a rush, and we know the road can get bad once the rain comes.
Oven door won't close all the way, the spring is broke. Stove top still cooking fine. Seven of us in this house, three generation, so we cook lots and want the oven fixed.

We have noticed cockroaches in the kitchen cupboards for the last couple of weeks and it's getting worse. I have tried sprays from the shop but they keep coming back. I look after my elderly mother, who lives here with me. Can someone come and do a proper treatment while the road is still open?
Side door with the ramp jammed shut since this morning, partner uses a wheelchair and can't get in or out. Other door only has steps, house still locks fine.

Tenant reports mice in the kitchen and laundry, with droppings found in the pantry over the last week. She says there are eight people living in the three-bedroom house, including two babies, and asks for pest control when available.

Tenant says the air con in one bedroom is dripping water down the inside wall but is still blowing cold. Eight people live in the three-bedroom house, two of them babies, and she asks that it be looked at when the crew is next around.
Shower head leaking at the join, drips all day. Water and hot water otherwise fine.

The flyscreen door at the back came off its top hinge last week and now drags on the ground. The main door behind it still locks fine. There are eleven of us in this three-bedroom house, from my elderly nan down to the baby, so that door gets opened all day. Could someone come and rehang it when they can?

Tenant says the ceiling fan in the lounge wobbles and makes a clicking noise, but the air con is still working. Report taken over the phone as the adults in the house do not read or write; they ask for it to be checked next time the crew is out that way, road permitting.

The kitchen cupboard door under the sink came off its hinge a couple of weeks ago and now it just leans there. We put it to the side so nobody knocks it. Our son has a long-term condition and we look after him every day, so we don't get much time to fix things ourselves. Can someone come have a look when the crew is out this way, before the road gets cut off in the wet.
Shower head dripping all day and night, won't stop even with the tap shut tight. One of us goes to dialysis three days a week, just letting you know for when the barge crew comes.
Toilet blocked, won't flush at all since last night. Big mob in the house right now with family staying, only the one toilet.

Tenant says the clothesline in the back yard has come loose at the base and is leaning over, she can still hang some washing on it. She has newborn twins and a four-year-old so there is a lot of washing. Asked if it can be fixed next time the crew flies in.
The air con in back bedroom it drip lots of water outside the window. Still blowing cold okay. Just want somebody check it next time they come out, the road still open now.

No water coming out any tap in the house since yesterday morning, kitchen, shower, toilet all dry. We got a little one two years old and my partner has diabetes, need water for them. We been carrying bottles from next door. Please send someone, road still good for now.

Tenant reports there has been no water to the house since early this morning, nothing from the taps and the toilet won't refill. She has newborn twins and a four-year-old and needs water for bottles and bathing. Neighbours have water so she thinks it's just her line.

Our toilet blocked up yesterday afternoon and won't flush, the water just sits high in the bowl. It's the only toilet in the house so we have nowhere to go. We have a relative staying who just came out of hospital after an operation and needs to use it often. Nothing has come out onto the floor, it's just not working.

Water stopped coming through the taps two days ago and it still hasn't come back. I'm seven months pregnant and we have a toddler, so it's hard without water for drinking, washing and the toilet. We're filling buckets at the store when we can. Please send someone out soon in case the road closes when the rain comes.
Hot water system not working no more, only cold water come out the shower and kitchen. It stop yesterday after work. I check the switch, it still on.

Tenant says the kitchen tap is stuck on and keeps running into the sink, she can't turn it off and it's wasting water but the sink is draining fine. She is pregnant and lives with her mother and two siblings. Asked for a plumber as soon as one can get out there.

The handle on the laundry door started wobbling last month and now it turns loose. The door still closes and locks, you just have to push it hard. My two teenagers keep pulling on it so it's getting worse. Could you fix it on the next trip out, the road's fine at the moment.
Key snapped off inside the front door lock, can't open it from outside now. Back door still locks so we're coming and going that way.

One of the hotplate on the stove don't heat up anymore, other three still working. Cooking for five on three plates take longer and the kitchen get real hot, tin roof and no trees outside. Can fix when the plane bring the crew.
Air con stopped dead this morning, no cool air in any room. I'm in my seventies and live on my own.

Air con in the lounge make a loud rattle noise when it going, but still cooling the room. The house get very hot in the afternoon and my wife having our first baby next month, so we need it keep going. We a long way out so maybe check it when crew come this way.
Back screen door hanging off one hinge, can't open it for a breeze. House gets very hot by the afternoon.
Lots of cockroach in the kitchen and bathroom, we see them every night now. We clean but they keep coming back. House get so hot under the tin roof, maybe that why they come in.
Power gone to half the house, fridge and lights in the kitchen off. Nothing sparking or burning, just dead, and I'm an old fella on my own out here.
Slow drip under the kitchen sink, bucket half full each day. One of us on dialysis three times a week, if that matters.

Tenant says no water has come out of any tap in the house since yesterday morning, so he can't wash or flush the toilet. He is an older man with limited mobility, lives alone and can't carry water over from the neighbours. He asks that the crew check the road first as it gets boggy out his way.

We came home from work two days ago and there was no water in the house at all. The taps just hiss and nothing comes out, so we can't shower, flush the toilet or cook. We've been buying bottled water from the shop since then. The road is still dry at the moment so a truck should get through.

Rats have taken over our kitchen over the last week or so and there are droppings on every bench and in the cupboards. Tenant says the front door has jammed in its frame and won't open at all, so the family are going in and out through the back door, which still locks. She and her husband are elderly and are looking after three grandchildren under six, and getting the little ones and the pram out the back is hard.

Since the storm on the weekend, water has been dripping through the ceiling in the back bedroom every time it rains. It's getting worse with each storm though, so we'd like someone out soon.

This morning the switchboard out the back started buzzing and there's a strong burnt smell coming from it. Now sparks come out of the kitchen powerpoint whenever the fridge kicks in. The hot water system outside has been dripping from the little pipe on the side for about a fortnight. We still get plenty of hot water, it's just wasting water and leaving a puddle on the ground. Our adult son has a disability and needs daily care, so we'd like it fixed before it turns into a bigger job.

Toilet not flushing proper for three days now, the water just sit there and go down very slow. Seven of us in this house, two adult and five kids, too many people for this place and the littlest one still a baby. Nothing come up on the floor but we only got the one toilet. Crew got to come on the barge or the plane.

Our stove stopped working completely last week, none of the hotplates or the oven heat up anymore. Bathroom light not working, new globe in and still nothing. Old man here on my own, rest of the lights fine.

Tenant reports cockroaches have infested the kitchen so badly the family of six can no longer store or cook food in there. She says one adult in the house has kidney disease and they are worried about keeping things clean. Crew base is not far and the road is passable.

No water come out the taps since yesterday, whole house dry. Grandfather he old and got a bad heart, he can't be carrying water from the tank down the road. We can't flush or wash nothing. Crew only close by, please come quick.
Tenant says the flyscreen door at the back no longer closes by itself and the latch is loose. She is pregnant and lives with her mother and two siblings. The front and back doors still lock properly.
Tenant reports the kitchen tap drips all the time even when turned off hard. He moved in last month and says it was already like that when he got the keys.

Power gone in the back half of the house since last night, the fridge and the air con both not running. Nothing sparking or burning, just dead. Seven of us living here, too crowded already and now no fridge for the food. Can someone come fix it soon.

Tenant says a section of gutter at the front has come loose and bangs in the wind, but there are no leaks inside. She and her husband are elderly and care for three grandchildren under six. Officer notes the crew would need to come in on the barge or the plane.

The air con in the main bedroom has started rattling loudly when it runs, and water is dripping down the outside wall under it. It still cools the room fine. There are eleven of us in this three-bedroom place, including my nan who is getting on and a toddler, so that room gets a lot of use. Whenever the crew is out this way is fine, the road is open at the moment.

Bedroom door handle broke, it come right off in my hand last week. I'm an old lady and my daughter she put a chair there to keep the door shut. Front and back door still lock good. No rush, just next time crew come out.
Front door frame split, lock busted, door won't shut or lock at all. House wide open and I'm out on night shift.

The hot tap in the laundry keep dripping, it don't turn off proper no more. Hot water still working for showers. My mum is old and she live here with me, she worry about the water bill. Road still open for now, before the wet come.
Aircon in the bedroom rattling loud and only blowing half cold, still running though. Real hot out here already, can a crew check it next time the plane or barge comes over.

Clothesline out the back fell over, the pole is rusted through at the bottom. We got nine people in this house so the washing is never stopping. Two of the kids is under five and the line lying on the ground where they play. Can someone come put a new one in.

Two of the hotplates on the stove stopped heating last week, the other two and the oven still work. I cook for my elderly father who lives here with me, so we are managing but it is slow. Our road gets cut when it rains a lot, so it would be good to get it fixed before then.

The bathroom basin tap has been dripping for about two weeks now and it is getting worse. We still have water everywhere else in the house. My relative is staying with us while she recovers from surgery and she uses that sink a lot. Could someone come out before the road goes bad in the wet.

The bedroom door handle came off in my hand on the weekend and now the door won't latch shut. Front and back doors still lock fine. We have a family member recovering from an operation sleeping in that room and she wants a bit of privacy. Please book someone in when the crew is coming out our way, before the wet closes the road.

After the wind last Tuesday a piece of the gutter at the front came loose and is hanging down. The roof is not leaking and nothing is inside. My partner has severe asthma, so we would like it fixed before it gets worse. We know the road can close in the wet so sooner would be better.

Since yesterday afternoon there has been no water coming out of any tap in the house. We cannot flush the toilet, wash or cook and we are carrying water from next door. We have three kids and the youngest is eighteen months, still in nappies. Please send a plumber as soon as you can.
Toilet blocked, won't flush, nothing coming back up. Old fella here on my own, no other toilet in the house.

The flyscreen door at the back is hanging off one hinge, it won't close right. The main door still lock ok. It get very hot in here with the tin roof and no trees, so we need the screen to keep the door open for air. Kids keep bumping into it.

Tenant says power went off to the kitchen and back bedrooms overnight and the fridge and stove are not working; no sparks or burning smell. She and her husband are elderly and are looking after three grandchildren under six. Breaker will not reset.

The front door lock broke yesterday, the key just spin around and we cant open it from inside or outside. We using the back door now, that one still lock. My partner is pregnant, baby due next month, and she worry if we need to leave quick. Please fix the lock soon.

Our hot water system stopped working two days ago and there has been only cold water since. Our adult son has a disability and we wash and shower him every day, which is very hard with cold water. Tenant reports the only toilet in the house will not flush and the cistern does not fill, so the family has no working toilet. Nothing is overflowing inside. Two adults and a child at home; officer took the report by phone as tenants prefer to talk rather than write.

Tenant says the outside garden tap near the back step is leaking constantly and is wasting water. Couple are retired and say the house faces west and gets very hot, fans only, so they want the tap working to water the shade plants. No other water problems.
No power to the whole back half of the house since this morning, fridge off. Breaker won't stay up, nothing sparking or burning.
Shower head dripping all the time, washer gone probably. No rush, whenever the crew comes over on the barge.
No water coming out the taps since this morning. Kitchen, shower, toilet all nothing. I been getting water from the store where I work but cant flush or wash at home. Need a plumber please.

Last night the key snapped off inside the front door lock and now that door will not open at all. We are using the back door, which still locks, but it opens straight onto the driveway. Kitchen sink tap is leaking from the bottom, water dripping in the cupboard all the time. We put a bucket there but it fill up quick. Seven of us in this house so that sink get used all day. Road still open for now but the wet is coming.
Aircon not working since yesterday, house like an oven. Just me, an old lady, with two grandkids, the little one only four.

I know the crew has to come on the plane or the barge but someone needs to look at it before it catches fire.

This morning the pipe under the kitchen sink split and water went everywhere. We turned off the little tap under the sink and cleaned it up, but now there is no water in the kitchen at all. My partner has severe asthma, so I'm the one carrying buckets from the bathroom for cooking and washing up. Please send someone before the road gets cut off.

Tenant says the front door frame split when the wind slammed it last night and the door won't close or lock now. He is an elderly man who lives on his own and can't get around easily, and he has no way to secure the house. Officer notes the road in is dirt and could close if it rains.

For about two weeks we've been seeing cockroaches all through the kitchen, mostly at night around the sink and behind the fridge. We've tried the spray from the shop but they keep coming back. We have a relative staying with us who is recovering from surgery, so we'd like the house treated properly. Any time the pest people are coming out this way is fine.

Tenant reports the lock on the front door is jammed and the key won't turn, so the family can only get in and out through the back door. She says the back door still locks fine at night. She is pregnant and finds it hard going round the side of the house in the dark.
Sliding door off its track, won't open. House gets really hot by the arvo and that door is our main breeze.

Our toilet stopped flushing two days ago, the water just sits in the bowl and goes down really slowly. I know you have to fly in or come on the barge but please put us on the list.
Shower drain real slow, water sits round your feet for ages. Not blocked all the way.

The aircon in my son's bedroom started rattling loudly when it runs, about a week ago. It still blows cold air and the other rooms are fine. It's just the noise keeps the kids up at night. Could someone check it next time they're around.

There's a slow drip coming from the pipe on the side of the hot water system outside, it started a few weeks back. We still have plenty of hot water, so it's not stopping anyone showering. There are four of us here and we're all at work during the day, so a call before coming would help. Just don't want it wasting water or getting worse.

The clothesline out the back snapped at the base last weekend and is now lying on the ground. Our adult son has a disability and needs daily care, so there is a lot of washing to dry every day. We are hanging things over the fence for now. Whenever the crew is next out this way would be fine.

Shower tap in the bathroom broke, the handle just spinning round and no water come out. That the only shower and we got nine people living here, two of them little ones under five. Kitchen tap and toilet still working so we filling a tub to wash the kids. Only barge or plane out here so please tell us when someone coming.

Tenant reports the front left hotplate on the stove has stopped heating, the other three still work. She has newborn twins and a four-year-old and says she is managing with the other hotplates for now.

No water come out of any tap since this morning, kitchen, shower, nothing. Toilet won't flush neither cause no water. I check the tap at the meter outside and it is on. Need somebody come look today if can.

Tenant says the bathroom basin tap has been dripping for a few weeks and won't turn off properly. She is pregnant and lives with her mother and two siblings. She says it is not stopping them using the bathroom.

The first big storm came through two nights ago and water started dripping through the ceiling in the back bedroom. It leaks again every time it rains, so we've had to move everyone out of that room. There are eleven of us in three bedrooms, including my grandmother and two little kids, so losing a room is really hard. The road out here gets cut when the wet sets in, so we'd like it fixed before then.
Front door handle snapped off inside the lock, door stuck shut. Getting in round the back, that one still locks.

Tenant reports the kitchen light stopped working last week and she has tried a new globe but it still won't come on. All other lights and power points are working. She is pregnant and lives with her mother and two siblings.

Tenant says the clothesline out the back has snapped off at the base and is lying on the ground. She reports eight people living in the three-bedroom house, two of them babies, so there is a lot of washing and nowhere to hang it. Happy to wait for the next barge or plane visit.

Tenant reports a few roof sheets have come loose at one corner and rattle when the wind gets up, and a gutter is hanging down at the front. Inside is dry and the ceiling looks fine. No water coming from any tap in the house since yesterday morning. We been carrying buckets from next door but it not enough for drinking and washing. My wife is pregnant, baby coming next month, so we really need the water back. Crew can come on the plane or barge.

About an hour ago a pipe burst under the kitchen sink and water is pouring out across the floor. It is going into the lounge and the hallway now and I can't find how to turn it off. I care for my elderly mum who lives with me and I'm worried she will slip. Please send someone fast, I know you have to fly or come by barge.

The closer on our flyscreen door broke last week so the door just swings and bangs in the wind. The main door still locks fine, it's only the screen. My partner has severe asthma. Could someone come and fix or replace the closer when they can.
Tenant says the laundry tap has been dripping for a couple of weeks and is getting worse. She has newborn twins and a four-year-old at home and asks for a plumber when one is free.
Couple of roof screws loose over the back verandah, sheet flaps a bit in wind. No leak inside.

Kitchen cupboard door come off its hinge, it hanging on one side now. Also the bathroom towel rail fell off the wall. I am pregnant so would be good to have it fixed before baby comes, when you got time.
Bedroom aircon making a loud rattle. Still blows cold, just noisy, needs a service.
Power point in the lounge sparking and smoking, smells like burning. Old nan here on my own with two grandkids, littlest is four, please hurry, road might get cut.

Back door handle is loose and wobbling, still locks but feel like it come off soon. Big mob in this house, two of us and five kids, littlest one is a baby under one year. Can someone fix it next time crew come out, before wet season close the road.

Water only a trickle from all the taps since three days now. Take long time to fill even one bucket. My grandad living with us, he old and he got a heart problem, and we got two little ones too. Please send plumber, we only short drive from the depot.

Tenant reports no water to the house since yesterday, all taps dry and toilet can't be flushed. Eight people living in three bedrooms, including two infants. She notes the road can close if rain comes.

Two days ago the water stopped and nothing comes out of the taps now. We can't flush the toilet or have a shower and we're buying bottled water to drink. My partner has severe asthma. The road is still open for now but rain could close it.
Our stove not working at all, no hotplates and no oven since the weekend. Nothing burning or smelling, it just dead. We can't cook any meals at home now, been living on takeaway.
Shower tap won't shut off properly, drips all day. Probably just a washer.
Tenant says the hot water system stopped working two days ago and there is only cold water. He is an older man living alone who doesn't get around easily and finds washing in cold water very hard.
Tenant says the toilet keeps running after every flush and has to have the lid lifted to stop it. Moved in last month and only noticed it recently.

Tenant reports the only toilet in the house blocked last night and won't flush or go down, nothing has come up or overflowed. She has newborn twins and a four-year-old and can't use the toilet at all.

Yesterday the key snapped off inside the front door lock and now the door won't open at all. We have to use the back door, which has steps that are hard going for both of us in our eighties. The house still locks up fine from the back. Could someone come and fix the front lock soon.
Aircon in the baby's room rattling real loud, still blowing cold but the noise keeps waking our newborn. Can someone come check it.

Tenant reports a pipe has burst under the house and water is pouring out across the floors, and the family has no water to the taps or toilet since they shut off what they could. She says there are eight people living in the three-bedroom house, including two babies, and they have nothing to wash or flush with. The dirt road in is still open for now but she is worried if rain comes.

Tenant says the hot water system has stopped heating and they have had only cold water for a few days now. He reports the house faces west and gets very hot through the afternoon, with only fans to cool it. Officer notes a crew would need to come in by plane or on the barge.

Tenant says some roof sheets have lifted over the back bedroom and rain drips through the ceiling every time it showers, so nobody can sleep in that room. She reports eight people in the three-bedroom house, two of them babies, and they are all now crammed into the other rooms.

Power point in the kitchen been sparking and gone black around it, smell like something burning. We switch it off at the box but now the whole house got no power, no fans nothing. Tin roof and no trees, inside the house is cooking hot.

Last week the back hotplate on our stove stopped heating up. The other three still work and the oven is fine, so we can still cook. There's eleven of us living here, my nan and the two babies too, so we end up cooking in turns and it takes ages. Could someone come and replace the hotplate when they get a chance.
Only toilet blocked, won't flush since yesterday, nothing coming back up but can't use it. House full with family staying for the season, road still dry for now.
Pipe under the kitchen sink busted this morning and water is coming out everywhere, kitchen and hallway all flooded now. We can't find where to turn it off. The dirt road still ok for car to get in.

A couple of weeks back the flyscreen door at the back came off its top hinge and now it drags on the ground. The front and back doors still lock fine at night. There's eleven of us in the house with my grandfather and the babies, so that screen door gets used all day long. If the crew is coming out our way before the wet, could they fix it.

The light in our hallway stopped working a few nights ago. We put in a new globe but it still won't come on. Everything else in the house has power. My brother is staying with us while he gets over his operation, so it would be good to have it sorted.
Cockroaches all through the kitchen cupboards, getting worse every week. I'm getting on in years and looking after my two grandkids, youngest is four, need a spray done please.
Back screen door latch is broke, it won't stay shut and wind keep banging it open. The main door still lock ok. Please send someone when you can.

Tenant says the front door lock has jammed and the door will not open at all, so he has to get in and out through the back, which is hard going for him at his age. He can still lock the back door at night. Officer notes the road out there is dirt and it is a long drive for the crew.
Oven door don't shut proper, the rubber seal all gone so it take long time to cook. Stovetop still working ok. I got diabetes so I cook my own food at home, for me and the little one, she two.
Tenant reports the kitchen tap drips all the time, even when turned off hard. Water is working fine everywhere else in the house. They are happy to wait for the next crew trip out that way.

Half the house got no power since last night, fridge and kitchen plugs all dead. Nothing sparking or burning, the switch in the box just won't stay up. Too many of us squeezed in here with a baby, and the baby milk in the fridge going off.
Tenant reports the outside light by the front door has stopped working and a new globe did not help. Power inside the house is all fine.
Shower head leaking at the joint, sprays all over the wall. Full house with family staying, shower going all day.

Yesterday afternoon the power to the kitchen and the bedrooms went off, and it hasn't come back even after I flicked the switch in the box. The fridge is off so the food is spoiling, and the bedroom fans don't work either. Nothing is burning or sparking, it just won't come on. I'm seven months pregnant with a toddler at home, so we need it fixed soon.
Tenant reports the key snapped off inside the front door lock and the door can no longer be opened from outside. They are coming and going through the back door, which still locks properly.

The storm the night before last lifted a couple of roof sheets at the back, and now water drips through the ceiling in my mum's bedroom every time it rains. Could someone please fix the roof before the next lot of rain?

The back screen door has dropped on its hinges and now scrapes along the floor. My dad is getting on and uses that door to get out to the yard, and he really struggles to drag it open. The main door behind it still locks fine, so it's just the screen. It's been getting worse over the last few weeks.

Tenant says a couple of gutter brackets on the front verandah have come loose and the gutter is hanging down at one end. No leaks inside the house. She only moved in last month and noticed it while unpacking, happy for it to be done when the crew is next out before the road gets bad.

Tenant reports the handle has come off the main bedroom door and it won't latch, so she can't keep it shut while her newborn twins are sleeping and the four-year-old keeps wandering in. Front and back doors lock fine. She'd like it fixed next time the crew comes out, before the wet closes the road.
Hot water system dripping from the pipe on top, puddle down by the wall. Still getting hot water, but the house cooks by the arvo and that side's worst, so can someone look at it when the crew's out.

Tenant reports power has been off to the kitchen and back bedrooms since yesterday; the switch in the switchboard flicks off every time she pushes it up, nothing burning or sparking. Tenant reports the stove and oven stopped working altogether over the weekend and they have no way to cook; no gas smell or burning. She says the house faces west and gets extremely hot by the afternoon with only fans to cool it, so they can't even use a camp burner inside.
One hotplate on the stove not heating up. Other three and the oven are fine.

During the storm on Sunday night part of the roof over the laundry and bathroom lifted. It's me and my two teenagers and we're washing at my sister's place for now. I rang on Monday but nobody has come out yet.

Tenant says there's been no water at all to the house since yesterday morning, taps and toilet both dry, while the neighbours still have water. Toilet blocked, won't flush since yesterday, only one in the house. Just me, an old lady, and my two grandkids, little one is four.

Air con in the lounge making big rattle noise when it going, but cold air still coming out ok. Me and my daughter living here, I'm old woman and that noise keep me awake at night. The bedroom one working good, so can fix whenever the workers come out our way.

Tenant reports the flyscreen on the front door is torn and the closer is broken so the screen swings open by itself; the wooden door behind it still locks. She has newborn twins and a four-year-old, and the little one keeps leaving it open and the flies get in to the babies.

Smoke alarm in the hallway keep beeping every minute all night and pressing the button not stopping it. My wife she pregnant, baby coming next month, and she not sleeping because of it. We not sure if we allowed to pull it down so we leave it, please send someone.
Ants coming in through the kitchen window frame again. Sprayed twice, keep coming back.

Power point in the bedroom went black and was sparking when we plug in the fan, now whole room smell like burning. The cover is cracked and you can see wires inside. Tenant reports the key snapped off in the front door lock this morning and the door is now stuck locked, so it can't be opened from inside or out. The family is coming and going through the back door, which still locks. She is pregnant and lives with her mother and two siblings.
Oven light's gone and the rubber seal on the oven door is peeling off. Still cooks ok.

Front door won't open no more, the handle broke off inside and it stay locked shut. We got to go in and out through the laundry door now, that one still lock ok. My wife pregnant with our first, baby due next month, and she not happy going round the back in the dark.
No water out of any tap since this morning. House gets boiling by the afternoon and the kids can't even have a drink or a wash.
Half the house got no power since yesterday, fridge and back rooms dead, lights out. One of us is on dialysis three days a week, and the crew has to come in by barge or plane.

The ceiling fan in the little bedroom got a wobble and it make a clicking noise, it still going but only slow. Nine of us living in this house and the two little ones under five sleep in that room. The aircon in the lounge still working okay.

Tenant says the hot tap in the shower drips all the time and the handle is hard to turn off. She reports the hot water itself is still working fine. Tenant is pregnant and asks for it to be fixed before the wet, as the road out can close.
Rats got into the kitchen cupboards, droppings all through and chewed packets, can't keep or cook any food in there now. Old fella in my seventies, living on my own.
Only toilet in the place is blocked and won't flush since last night. Water sitting high in the bowl but hasn't come over, I'm home through the day sleeping after night shift.

Tenant says the aircon unit in the main bedroom is dripping water down the wall underneath it, but it still cools the room fine. She has newborn twins and a four-year-old and asks for someone to look at it when they can.
Clothesline came off its post and is lying on the ground. Got a newborn so heaps of washing to hang, and the road gets bad in the wet.

Power gone in the whole house since yesterday arvo, the neighbours still got theirs. Seven of us living here and the baby not even one yet, all the food in the fridge going off. Nothing burning or sparking, it just dead. Road might close if the rain come.
Laundry light not working, already put a new globe in. Someone here does dialysis three days a week so other days are easier for a visit.
