Flyscreen door hanging off its bottom hinge, flies getting in everywhere. Nan here with my two grandkids, little one's four, front door still locks fine.

Tenant reports the toilet has been blocked since yesterday and will not flush; water sits in the bowl but has not overflowed. He is an elderly man living alone and it is the only toilet in the house. Dirt road out to the community is still passable at the moment.

Wire hanging out from the ceiling fan in the lounge and it sparking when we flick the switch. We turn off the power at the box now so no fans, no aircon, nothing. This house got tin roof and no shade trees, inside getting real hot. Please send electrician quick.
Roof iron came loose in that big wind, water leaking into the hallway when it rains. Road still open for now.
Aircon not working at all since two days, not blowing nothing. My husband he got diabetes and we got a little one two years old. Only the ceiling fans going now.

We've had cockroaches in the kitchen and bathroom for a few weeks now and it's getting worse. There's eleven of us across three bedrooms, from my old mum down to the baby, so it's hard to keep on top of it. We've tried the spray from the shop but they keep coming back. Could someone come and do a proper treatment when the crew next flies in?
Tenant says the sliding door at the back sticks on its track and is hard to close since she moved in last month. She can still lock it but has to lift the door up before the latch will catch.
Hot water system dripping water out the pipe at the bottom all the time. Still got hot water ok but it making the ground wet and muddy near the back step. Been like that maybe two weeks now.

Tenant reports the kitchen tap drips all day and night and the washer seems worn out, though water is still running fine. She mentions one of the adults has kidney disease and the family would like it sorted before the wet, when the dirt road can get cut.

Late last night the toilet started backing up, and this morning sewage is coming up through the shower drain all over the bathroom floor. It has now spread out into the hallway and the smell is terrible. My husband and I are both in our eighties and we can't clean this up ourselves. The road is still open for now but it closes once the rain starts.

Caller says the flyscreen door at the front has come off its bottom hinge and drags along the floor. He is an elderly man and finds it heavy to push, but the main door behind it still locks fine. Happy for it to be done whenever the crew next comes over by barge or plane.

Cockroaches everywhere in the kitchen, in the cupboards and under the fridge too. We got a little one two years old who putting everything in her mouth, and my partner got diabetes so we got to keep the food clean. Need someone come spray please.
Tenant reports the key keeps jamming in the front door lock and takes a few goes to turn. He is elderly and lives alone and is worried the key will snap off in it, but the door does still lock.
New tenant, moved in a few weeks back, reports the laundry tub is slow to empty and the tap under it has a small leak into the cabinet. Water otherwise working normally.

A few days ago the handle on our back door came loose and now it wobbles every time we open it. My husband tightened the screws but it worked loose again by the next day. We're both getting on in years and would rather a tradesman fixed it properly. The door still shuts and locks for now.

Tenant rang to say the steel stand under the big water tank beside the house has rusted through and the tank is leaning over toward the bedroom wall, with the legs starting to buckle. She says it looks like it could come down any time and the family is keeping away from that side. Tenants do not read, so please phone back rather than write.

Tenant reports the shower tap will not turn off fully and the shower head leaks, so it drips all day. There are eight people in the three-bedroom house including two babies, so the bathroom is in use constantly. Officer notes the road in is dirt and can close in the wet.
Aircon in the baby's room rattling really loud. Still blowing cold but keeps waking our newborn.

Pipe under the kitchen sink burst this morning, water spraying out everywhere and the whole floor flooded now. We turned the tap off at the meter but it still coming out. My grandfather is old and got a bad heart, he can't be walking around in this water. Road is dirt and long way, please send somebody quick.
Big ant nest inside the wall by the back window, ants all through the kitchen. House gets real hot by afternoon so can't keep the windows shut to stop them.

Our stove stopped working, none of the hotplates come on and oven is dead too. No smell or nothing, it just won't turn on. We got three kids to feed and can't cook them proper meals. Tin roof and no shade here, too hot to be cooking outside on a fire in the afternoon.

Oven and stove both not working since few days, switch is on but nothing heating. Seven of us in this house, three generations, everybody need feeding and we only got a little camp burner outside. Nothing burning or smoking, it just dead. We know crew come by barge or plane so let us know when.

About a week ago the shower started draining slowly, and now the water sits around our feet for a while after each shower. We've tried pouring hot water down it but it hasn't helped. The toilet and sinks are all working fine. It can wait until the crew next comes over on the barge.

Bad smell coming up from the drain outside near the laundry, worse in the afternoon. Nine people living here and two little ones under five, they always playing out the back. Toilet and showers all still going down ok. Can fix next time the barge come.

Around dinner time last night the power point in the lounge started sparking and now there's a black burn mark on the wall around it. We switched it off at the box but the plug was hot and smelled like burning plastic. Our adult son has a disability and needs care every day, so we can't just leave the house. The dirt road is still open for now if someone can come.

Tenant reports a big section of roof sheeting tore off in the storm overnight and water is pouring through the ceiling in the main bedroom. She says the ceiling is sagging and looks like it could come down, so the family has moved out of that room. Tenant cannot read, so please call rather than send a letter.

Tenant rang to say the toilet won't flush and the drain outside is blocked, so the family has no working toilet at all. She reports nothing has come back up inside the house but they are going to a relative's place to use the toilet. Road out there is still dry for now.

Our hot water system stopped working two nights ago, the water from every tap is just cold. We checked the switch in the box and it is on, there's no leak, it just isn't heating. My partner has bad asthma and washing in cold water is hard on them, so we've been boiling the kettle to wash. The road is still open but it gets cut once the rain starts.
Back door jammed shut, won't open at all so no air through the house and it's like an oven by the arvo. Front door still locks fine.

The toilet stopped flushing yesterday morning and plunging it hasn't helped. The water just sits in the bowl and won't go down, but nothing has come out onto the floor. There's two kids here and my brother is staying with us while he gets over his operation, and he can't be walking to the neighbours to use theirs. The road is still open but the wet is not far off.
Sliding door to the verandah keeps sticking on the track, hard for my husband to push it open from his wheelchair. Still closes and locks ok.

The stove went dead three days ago, none of the hotplates or the oven will come on. Nothing smells burnt, it just won't turn on at all. We can't cook proper meals and our son has a disability and needs his food made up for him every day. The dirt road out is still dry if someone can get here before the rain.

Big storm last night and part of the ceiling in the kids room come down, the rest still hanging and cracking. Roof sheet on top is flapping loose too, might come right off. Nine of us living here and two little ones under five, we got nowhere else to put them to sleep. Need someone to make it safe today.

Half the power points in the house stopped working yesterday afternoon, including the fridge and the ones in the kids' rooms. The lights still work and nothing is burning or smoking, the switch in the box just won't stay up. We've got three kids and the youngest is only eighteen months, and I need the fridge for her milk.
Kitchen tap keeps dripping, washer's gone I reckon. Whenever the crew is next over on the plane is fine.

Tenant reports the relief valve on the hot water system is dripping steadily outside, though they still have hot water. She says it's a west-facing house with only fans and it gets very hot in the afternoons. Happy for it to be looked at when the crew next comes over on the barge.
Air con stopped working two days ago, it just blowing warm air now. We tried turning it off at the switch and back on, still no cold coming. Only one unit in the house and that one gone.
Toilet blocked, won't flush at all, only one in the house. Nothing overflowing, just no toilet.

Tenant reports cockroaches through the kitchen cupboards and ants coming in around the back door. He is an older man living on his own and asks if pest control can come out on the next trip. The road in is open at the moment.

Lots of cockroaches in the kitchen and bedrooms, they come out every night. Seven of us living in this house, three lots of family, so it real hard to keep on top of it. Can someone come do the spraying next time the crew out this way.

Pipe under the house burst this morning and water going everywhere, it coming up through the laundry floor. I turned it off at the meter but it still running out. Now we got no water in the house to drink or wash and the floor all flooded.

A few of the gutters along the back of the house have come loose and sag when it rains. We noticed it after the last bit of rain a couple of weeks ago. Nothing is leaking inside, the water just pours over the edge. Whenever the crew next comes over on the barge would be fine.
No water out of any taps since this morning. No leaks anywhere I can see, just nothing coming through.

Tenant reports a couple of roof screws have worked loose over the front verandah and the sheet rattles in the wind. He says there are no leaks inside the house and it can wait for the next scheduled visit.

Front door got kicked in and the frame all split, door won't shut or lock now. Back door lock been broke a while so we can't lock the house up at all. My father is old and got a heart condition, he been up all night worrying. Need it made safe today please.
Shower drain slow, water sits a while before it goes down. Toilet and sinks fine.
Toilet won't flush, water just sits in the bowl and goes down really slow. Only toilet in the place.
Cockroaches all through the kitchen cupboards again. Can't keep the windows shut to keep them out, house is like an oven by the arvo.

We got mice in the house, they getting into the bread and the rice. Nine of us living here so hard to keep the food all locked away. Two little ones under five and I don't like them mice running round where the kids sleep.

Two days ago the water pressure dropped to a trickle and since this morning nothing comes out of any tap. We can't shower or wash up properly. Our son has a long-term condition and we look after him every day, so we really need water to care for him. Please send a plumber as soon as you can.
Tenant reports the bathroom basin tap drips all the time and won't turn off fully. She says she has newborn twins and a four-year-old at home. Water otherwise working fine.

Tenant says the garden tap at the back is leaking at the base and has made a muddy patch by the steps. She reports the house faces west and gets very hot in the afternoons with only fans. Road gets cut once the wet comes in, so she asked if it can be looked at before then.
Back door deadlock broken, key just spins. Slide bolt inside still holds it but I'm out on night shift and want a proper lock.

After the last big storm a couple of roof sheets over the verandah came loose at one corner and rattle when the wind picks up. Nothing is leaking inside and the rest of the roof looks okay. It's been like that about three weeks now. The road gets bad once the wet sets in, so it would be good to get it fixed before then.
Shower drain going real slow, water sitting there after every wash. My partner got diabetes and our little one is two, we just want it cleared before it get worse. Toilet still working okay.

Tenant says the hot water system has a small drip coming from the valve on the side and it's leaving a wet patch on the slab, but hot water is still working. Reports the house is west-facing and very hot in the afternoons with fans only. Happy for it to be booked in with the next crew out.

One of the back hotplates on the stove stopped heating last week. The other three and the oven still work, so we can still cook. We've got three kids and the youngest is only eighteen months, so it's a squeeze cooking for everyone. I know the road out our way is rough, but whenever a crew is passing would be good.

Since yesterday afternoon half the power points in the house have stopped working, including all the ones in the bedrooms. My partner has severe asthma and her nebuliser plugs in by the bed, so we're running an extension lead from the kitchen for now. We checked the switchboard and nothing is burning or sparking, the points are just dead. Could someone come out to fix it please.

The air con in the back bedroom makes a loud rattling noise when it starts up. It still cools the room fine, it's just noisy. Started about a fortnight ago. The road in here gets cut when the rain comes, so before the wet if possible.

There's a slow leak under the kitchen sink and we find a little puddle in the cupboard each morning. We noticed it about a week ago and have put a bowl under it. We're both in our eighties and can't get down there to look at it properly. The water is working fine otherwise.

Last night the front door lock jammed and the key won't turn from outside anymore. We had to come in through the back door, which still locks fine. We're both in our eighties and the back steps are hard for us every time. Please send someone to fix the front lock.

Front door frame come apart and the door hanging off the hinge, it won't close or lock no more. Can't lock up the house at all now. I got my two year old here and my partner got diabetes, we can't leave the place open like this tonight.

Tenant reports the air conditioner stopped working two days ago and they have no cooling at all in this build-up heat. She has newborn twins and a four-year-old at home. She knows crews come in by plane or barge but asks for someone as soon as possible.
Big roof sheet torn half off in the wind, flapping and banging over the kids' room, could come down any minute. House already like an oven by afternoon and now the ceiling's showing too.
Tenant says the air conditioner remote has stopped working and they have to turn the unit on and off at the wall, but it still cools fine. She reports one adult in the house has kidney disease.
Caller reports the shower head is leaking at the connection and spraying sideways onto the wall. Has newborn twins and a four-year-old in the home. Shower and taps otherwise working.
Toilet blocked up, won't flush at all and it's the only one in the house. Old man on my own here, can't sort it myself, and the road gets bad when the rain comes.

Last night the air con unit in the main bedroom started making a loud buzzing noise and then smoke came out the front of it. We switched it off at the wall but the power point is black and still smells like burning plastic. This morning there were sparks when one of us went near the plug. We have all moved out of that room and need someone to come make it safe, we know the crew has to fly or come by barge.

Toilet not working since couple days now, it won't flush and the water just sit there. Only got the one toilet so I been using the one at the store when I'm at work. Nothing coming out on the floor, it just don't go down. Need plumber come over on the next plane or barge.

Pipe burst under the kitchen sink, water pouring across the floor into the lounge, had to turn the water off at the meter so no water in the house now. Just me, an old lady, with my two grandkids, the little one only four.

Our hot water stopped working two days ago. We noticed it in the morning when the showers were all cold, and it's been cold ever since. We checked the switch in the meter box and it's on, but the tank isn't heating. There are four of us here working early shifts so we need it fixed please.

Power gone in the kitchen and the back bedrooms since yesterday, the lights in the front still working. Fridge not going so we lose the food and the baby milk. Nothing burning or sparking, just no power them rooms. Lot of us living here, two adults and five kids, the baby not even one yet, and road out here get muddy now.

The tap in the laundry has been dripping for about a month and now it doesn't fully turn off. Everything else in the house works fine and we still have water everywhere. I look after my mum who is elderly and lives with me, so I'd like it fixed before the wet season makes the road hard to get in on.

We have had no water coming out of any tap in the house since yesterday afternoon. There are eleven of us living here, grandparents, parents and the little kids, in three bedrooms. We can't flush the toilet, wash or cook and we are carrying water from next door in buckets. Nothing is leaking or flooding, the water just stopped.

Gutter on the back of the house hanging down, it come loose from the roof. Couple of roof screws gone too and the sheet rattle when the wind blow. Nine of us here and two little ones under five play out the back so we want it fixed proper. Road out to here is dirt, it go bad in the wet.
Hot water not working no more, since Sunday the shower only cold. We check the switch, it on but tank don't get hot. Just me and my partner here, can someone come fix it.

Toilet blocked, it won't flush and water stay in the bowl. Nothing come up on the floor but we got nine people using the one toilet. Two little ones under five and they keep needing to go. Please send plumber soon.

Since early this morning there has been no water coming through any of the taps or the toilet. Our neighbours have water so it seems to be just our house. Our adult son has a disability and needs daily care, including washing and changing, which we can't do without water. Nothing is leaking, we just have nothing coming out.

Tenant says the air con in the lounge room is making a rattling noise and dripping a little water down the wall, but it is still cooling the house. He is elderly, lives alone and has limited mobility, so he asks that the crew call before they come so he has time to get to the door.

Kitchen cupboard door come off the hinge, it hanging there now. The drawer under it stuck too, won't open. I got my medicine for diabetes in that cupboard and my two year old keep pulling on the door. Not a big rush, just when you can.

Tenant reports the kitchen tap won't turn off and has been running into the sink since yesterday; they can only stop it at the meter, which leaves them without water to use. She says the house faces west, they only have fans, and they are both struggling with how hot it gets inside in the afternoon.
Clothesline out the back broke, one of the arms snap off and it lean over now. My partner having the baby next month and we going to have lot of washing. Can someone come fix it when you got time.

About two weeks ago a section of the back fence fell over after a big wind and it is still lying on the ground. Three of the kitchen cupboard doors are also falling off their hinges. There are eleven of us in this three-bedroom house, from my old parents down to the little ones, so the kitchen gets a lot of use. Please come out before the road closes for the wet.

Tenant says the flyscreen on the back door is torn and the door catch is loose, though the door still locks. He reports the house faces west with fans only and gets very hot, so they keep that door open for air and the flies are getting in. Happy for it to be booked on the next barge or flight trip.

Toilet is blocked and won't flush since yesterday, water just stay in the bowl. It not coming out on the floor but we got no toilet now for the two of us and three kids. House is tin roof, no trees, real hot inside this time of year and having no toilet make it harder. Crew can come on barge or plane.
Stove and oven both dead, nothing heats up at all, no smell or anything. Newborn here and can't boil water for the bottles, road out here dirt and gets bad in the wet.

A pipe under the kitchen sink burst this morning before we left for work and water is pouring across the floor into the bedrooms. We turned it off at the meter, so now the whole house has no water, no shower and the toilet won't flush. Four of us live here and we all have to get to work. Please send someone before the rain cuts the road.

We've had no water coming out of any tap since the day before yesterday. My aunty is staying with us while she gets over her operation and she needs to wash and keep her wound clean. Nobody can shower and we're carting bottles over from next door. It's a long way out here so please send someone before the wet closes the road.

Tenant reports cockroaches all through the kitchen cupboards and ants coming in along the back wall. She says the house cooks in the afternoon sun with only fans, so they keep the doors open and the bugs keep getting in. Asks for a pest spray next time the crew is out.

Caller says the taps dropped to nothing last night and the toilet cistern isn't filling. She and her husband are in their seventies and are looking after three little grandkids under six, so having no water for washing or flushing is very hard. Asked for someone to come out today.

Tenant reports the shower drain is slow and water sits in the base for a while before it goes down; the toilet and other drains are working fine. He says the place gets really hot from the afternoon sun and they only have fans, so they're showering a lot more. Happy to wait for the next crew on the plane or barge.

Tenant says there has been no water to the house since yesterday arvo, the taps just cough air. She has newborn twins and a four-year-old and can't make up bottles or bath them, so she's borrowing water from family. Asks for a plumber as soon as the crew can get out along the dirt road.

Tenant reports the stove and oven have stopped working altogether; none of the hotplates heat up, no burning smell, it's just dead. She says she and her husband are elderly and minding three grandchildren under six, and they have no way to cook meals for the little ones. Requests a repair soon.

The hot water system outside has been dripping from a pipe on its side for about two weeks. We still get hot water fine in the shower and kitchen, it's just leaking onto the ground. I look after my old mum who lives here with me and I don't want it to get worse. No rush, whenever the crew is next out this way.
Fridge that came with the house stopped working two days ago, all my food going off. Old fella on my own here, can't get to the shop much.
Only toilet blocked since last night, won't flush at all. Partner's in a wheelchair, can't get to anyone else's toilet.

The kitchen tap broke two nights ago and now it won't turn off, water just runs into the sink day and night. It's going down the drain, not on the floor, but it's wasting heaps and the pressure everywhere else has dropped. I care for my elderly father here and he needs the bathroom working properly. The road out here can get cut once the rains start, so please come before then.

The front door lock jammed last night and the key won't turn either way, so the door is stuck shut. We've been going in and out the back, which still locks, but that means only one way out of the house. It's just me and my two teenagers and I'd like it sorted before the wet when the road gets cut.
No water at all from the taps since yesterday. Newborn here, can't wash bottles or bath bub.

The bathroom tap has been dripping for about a month and it's getting worse. Everything else works and we still have plenty of water. My brother is staying with us while he recovers from his surgery and the drip right next to his room keeps him awake. Can it be fixed when the crew next comes out, the road is still open for now.

Back door lock is broke, it stuck locked and key won't turn, so can't open it from inside or outside. Front door still locking okay but that the only way out now. My husband got diabetes and we got little one two years old, if something happen we only got one door. Please someone come fix it soon, the road is sealed all the way.

Tenant says the flyscreen door at the back has come off its top hinge and drags on the ground; the main doors still lock fine. She reports eight people living in the three-bedroom house including two babies, so that door gets a lot of use. Asks for it to be fixed when the crew is next in.

Water stopped coming to the house this morning and every tap and the shower are dry. Our son has a disability and we wash and care for him every day, so we really need it back on. We've been carrying buckets from the neighbours. It's a long drive for the crew and the road gets bad when it rains, so please come as soon as you can.

Tenant rang in as the adults in the house don't read or write; says the garden tap out the front is leaking at the base and making a muddy patch by the steps. House water is otherwise fine and she is happy for it to wait for the next crew visit.

Last night the power point in the lounge started sparking and now there's a black burn mark and a burning smell coming from it. I'm seven months pregnant and our toddler is always playing near that wall. We flicked it off at the switchboard but the lights in the other rooms keep flickering. Please send someone today, the dirt road gets slippery if more rain comes.

Tenant reports the bedroom door handle is loose and keeps falling off, and the wardrobe door has come off its track. Says she and her husband are getting on in years and are minding three grandkids under six who keep pulling at the handles. Front and back doors lock fine, no rush.

Tenant says the light in the back bedroom stopped working a couple of weeks ago and putting in a new globe did not fix it. Tenant reports the rest of the power in the house is fine and is happy for an electrician to come whenever one is next nearby.

Our bathroom basin tap started dripping about a week ago and it's getting worse. I tried tightening it but it still goes drip drip all night. Everything else with the water is working fine. We've got a toddler who keeps playing with that tap, so it would be good to get a new washer or tap put in.

Tenant reports the air conditioner stopped working completely three days ago and he has nothing else to cool the house. He is an old man living on his own and says he can't stay inside during the day now. Officer notes a tradie would need to come out by plane or on the barge.

Kitchen sink tap been leaking underneath, the cupboard always wet now. We got seven people in this house and a little baby so that sink get used all day. Still got water, just the leak need fixing. Next time the barge or plane bring workers out can they look at it please.
Only toilet in the house blocked, won't flush at all. Old lady here with my two grandkids, youngest only four, nowhere for us to go.
Lot of cockroaches in the kitchen, they come out every night now. I been spraying but they keep coming back. Can someone come do a pest spray while the road still open.

Tenant says the oven door won't stay shut and the oven doesn't hold its heat, but all the hotplates on top still work. Tenant reports eight people living in the three-bedroom house, including two babies, so they are doing all the cooking on the stovetop for now.

Gutter at the front come off in the big wind and now the water pour straight off the roof onto the verandah. Nine of us in this house, two little ones under five, and the verandah is where the kids play. Roof not leaking inside, just the gutter. Road get bad when it rain so maybe come before the wet.

The light in our bedroom stopped working about a fortnight ago. My husband changed the globe but it still won't come on, so we've been carrying a lamp in from the lounge. We're both in our eighties so we'd rather not get up on a ladder to check it ourselves. The rest of the power is fine, and we know the road gets cut in the wet, so whenever a crew can get out.

Last night the power point behind the fridge started sparking and there was a burning smell. This morning the plate is black around the edges and it crackles every time the fridge kicks in. My partner has bad asthma and we've pulled the plug but we're scared to touch anything else. We know the electrician has to come by plane or barge but please send someone straight away.

Half the house got no power since yesterday, the kitchen and two bedroom. Fridge not running so the food going off. Nothing sparking or burning, just nothing work on that side. Seven of us living in this house, too many for three rooms.

Outside tap at the back leaking, water keep running down the wall. My mum she's old, she live here with me and she like to water her garden from that tap. Inside water all ok. Road is dirt so come when it's dry.

The exhaust fan in the bathroom stopped working last week and the laundry light went out a few days later. We look after our adult son who has a disability and needs care every day, so we're in that bathroom with him a fair bit. Everything else in the house has power and is working. We know it's a long drive out here and the road can close, so sometime before the wet would be good.
Shower drain real slow, water just sits there after every wash. Partner's in a wheelchair and uses that shower.

The aircon in the kids room making a loud rattle when it run. It still cooling ok, just the noise keep the baby up. Seven of us in here so every room get used. Road can close in the wet so maybe come before that.
Toilet not flushing, it's blocked and that's the only toilet we got. My dad he old and got a bad heart, he need a toilet in the house. Dirt road out here but it still open now.

There's a crack running up the hallway wall that has been getting a bit longer over the last few months. The doors all still shut and lock fine and nothing is leaking. We're both in our eighties so we'd just like someone to have a look at it. The road out here is dirt and goes under in the wet, so maybe before then.
Back half of the house got no power since this morning, fridge and partner's wheelchair charger both on that side. No sparks or smell, just dead.

Tenant reports part of the bedroom ceiling came down overnight after heavy rain, with water pouring through and more of the ceiling sagging right above where her newborn twins sleep. She has moved the twins and her four-year-old into the lounge and says the rest could fall any minute. Asked for someone to come out today.
One of the hotplate on the stove not heating no more, the other three still work. Me and my mum live here, she's old and she do most of the cooking. Can someone come fix it when they can.
Toilet won't flush and the drain out the back is blocked, so no working toilet in the house now. Stinking hot out here and the barge isn't due for a while.
Kitchen tap dripping all day, won't turn off properly. One of us is on dialysis so we're in and out a lot, would be good to get it fixed.

The back screen door came off its top hinge on the weekend when the wind picked up. We've propped it against the wall for now and the front door is fine. It's not stopping us using the house, we just want it put back on before it gets bent. The road is still open so whenever a crew is out this way is good.

No water coming out of any tap since yesterday, kitchen and shower both. My partner she is due with our first baby next month and we got no water for drinking or washing. There is no leak we can see outside, it just stopped.
Ants all through the kitchen cupboards and along the skirting boards. Partner's in a wheelchair and can't get down low to put baits out, and the road gets cut in the wet.

We've had cockroaches in the kitchen and bathroom for about three weeks now and they're getting worse at night. My partner has bad asthma so we don't want to use the spray from the shop. Could someone come and do a proper treatment next time the crew is out. The road is still dry for now.

Over the last few nights rats have got into the kitchen and there are droppings all over the benches, the cupboards and the food. We've had to throw most of our food out and we can't safely make a meal in there now. My husband and I are both in our eighties and can't get down to clean under everything ourselves. Can someone come out and deal with them.

The tap out the back been leaking for a while now, making the ground all muddy by the steps. House gets real hot under that tin roof and the kids play out there with the hose to cool off. Tap still work, just won't turn off properly.

The water to our house stopped yesterday morning and nothing comes out of the taps or the shower. There are eleven of us in this three bedroom house so there's nowhere else to put everyone. We need someone today before more of it comes down.

Roof got damaged in the storm and now rain coming through the ceiling in the kids room every time it rain. We got nine people in this house so there is nowhere else for the two little ones to sleep. Buckets everywhere but the mattresses still getting wet. Please send someone to fix the roof.

My mum is old and she can't hang the washing now because the clothesline broke, one side fell right down. She been using that line for years. Not a big rush but can someone fix it when the crew is out this way. Road gets bad in the wet.

Last night the key snapped off inside the front door lock and now the front door won't open at all. There are eleven of us in this three-bedroom house, including my old dad and a baby, so everyone is going in and out the back way. Somebody kicked our front door in last night and the frame is all broke, door won't close no more. Can't lock the house at all. I got diabetes and my baby girl is only two, we don't feel safe sleeping here like this. Need someone to come make it safe today.
Kitchen tap keep dripping even when I turn it right off. Been like this couple weeks now. Not causing any trouble, just wasting water. Can someone come change the washer when they can.

Power gone off in the back half of the house since yesterday arvo, fridge and the lights in there not working. Nothing sparking or burning, it just dead. Me and my partner losing all our food. Road out here is dirt and it get closed when the big rain come, so please come before that.

Bit of the roof iron came loose in the wind and now rain leaking through the ceiling onto the beds. Seven of us in this house and the baby not even one yet, we all squeeze into the other room now. Just need the roof fixed. Road still open for now but in the wet it can close.

Tenant says the back left hotplate on his stove has stopped heating, but the other three hotplates and the oven still work. He is an older man who lives on his own and asks that the crew knock and wait a bit at the door.

Aircon in the lounge still cooling but it making a loud rattle and water dripping down the outside wall. My little one is two and I got diabetes so we keep it running most days. Can you send someone have a look next time the crew is out.

A couple of weeks ago one of the kitchen cupboard doors came off its hinge and now it is just leaning against the wall. My teenagers tried to screw it back on but the wood around the hinge is split. Stove stop working three days now, none of the hotplates or the oven come on. Two adults and five kids in this house and the youngest still a baby, too many mouths to feed with no stove. We been buying takeaway from the shop and it costing too much. Road is dirt and get cut when it rain lots.
Toilet not working, won't flush at all. Old fella here on my own, need it fixed.
Oven door not closing proper, stovetop still works. Just me, the old nan, and two grandkids, littlest is four.

The towel rail in the bathroom came off the wall on the weekend. Nothing else is broken and we can still use the bathroom fine. I'm seven months pregnant and we have a toddler, so my partner doesn't want it lying around on the floor. Could someone come and put it back up when they're free?
Hot water system dripping from the valve on the side, hot water itself still fine. No rush, know the crew has to come over by barge.

Ceiling fan in the lounge wobbling and noisy, aircon still good. I'm the nan here with my two grandkids, little one is four.

Flyscreen on the bedroom window got a big hole in it now, bugs coming in all night. Also the kitchen cupboard door hanging off on one hinge. Not a rush, just need someone fix them when they come out this way.
Hallway light not working. Put a new globe in, still nothing.

Front door handle come off this morning, door only open from inside now and the lock not working on that one. Back door still lock ok so we using that one to get in and out. Need someone come fix the front door, road is dirt and rain coming so better soon.

We've had no water at all from any tap since early this morning, and the toilet won't fill so we can't flush it. Bathroom tap dripping, won't turn off properly. Just me, old nanna, and the grandkids, littlest is four.
Shower head leaking all the time, drip drip even when the tap turned off hard. Been like that since last week, not getting better. Shower still work ok.
Toilet keep running after we flush it, water still going in the bowl a long time. Toilet still working fine, just wasting lot of water. Can somebody look at it next time they out here.

Aircon in the bedroom still going but making loud rattle noise, and not blowing strong like before. Rest of the house fine. Road might close soon with the rain so maybe come check it before then.

Key broke off inside the front door lock this morning. Door is locked now and we can't open it, so we only using the back door. Back door still lock ok. Road still good for driving at the moment, can somebody come out.

One power point in the laundry not working no more, the washing machine plug don't get power. All the other points and fans in the house still going good, we need them because that tin roof make the house real hot with no trees for shade. Kids is fine, just want that point fixed when you can.
Meter box out the front sparking and smoking, wires gone black. Big mob in the house right now with family staying, kids everywhere, need someone before the road gets cut.
Front cover off the bedroom air con, clip broke. Still blowing cold, no rush, next time someone's out on the plane.

No hot water since yesterday, heater just not going. House full, family here for the holidays, lots of kids needing a wash.

Gutter on the front of the house come loose and hanging down at one end, and there a rust hole in it too. No water coming inside, roof still ok. There seven of us living in this house so it pretty crowded, would be good if the crew fix it next time they come out.

We've had no water coming out of any tap in the house since yesterday morning, not in the kitchen, bathroom or the laundry. The toilet won't refill either so we can't flush it. Kitchen tap leaking all the time, drip drip, even when you turn it off hard. Water still working everywhere, just wasting it. House get real hot under the tin roof with no shade, kids drinking lots of water so we need that tap good. Road still open for now.

The shower head broken and spraying water every way, we still can use it but it make a big mess on the bathroom floor. Nine of us living here, two little ones under five, so that shower get used all day long. Can someone come fix it please.

No power in the whole house since last night, fridge off, nothing burnt or sparking that I can see. In my seventies and on my own here.

Back screen door is busted, mesh all torn and the closer broke so it bang open all day. Front door still lock ok. Nine people in this house with two babies under five, and the bugs getting in everywhere. We know it's a long way out on that road so might be a while.

Toilet blocked up and won't flush since two days, the drain outside gurgling too. Nothing coming up in the house but we got no toilet now. Seven of us living here and the baby not even one yet, too many people to have no toilet. Please send the plumber before the road close.

Tenant reports none of the hotplates or the oven will heat up, so he has no way to cook at home. He is an elderly man who lives alone. No burning smell or sparks reported.

Power been off in the whole back half of the house since yesterday. Fridge not going, no way to keep the baby milk cold. Two of us and five kids in here, littlest one not even one yet. No sparks or nothing, it just dead.
Power out to the bedrooms and kitchen since last night, front of the house still on, nothing sparking. My partner uses a wheelchair.

Hot water unit outside dripping from the overflow pipe, puddle under it. Still getting hot water fine.

Hot water system out the back is leaking little bit from the pipe at the bottom. Water still coming hot inside, no problem there. Just it drip all day and make the ground muddy. Can someone have a look next time they out this way.
No water from any tap since yesterday arvo, toilet won't fill either. Partner uses a wheelchair, can't manage without the toilet and shower.

One of the hotplates on my stove don't heat up no more, the front left one. Other three and the oven working fine so I still can cook. Just want it fixed when you got time.

Our air con stop working yesterday, it just turn on and nothing come out. Seven of us live here, three generations, everyone sleeping in the lounge with one fan now. Can you send someone to fix it quick.
Hot water tap in the bathroom basin won't turn off all the way, keeps dripping. Full house at the moment with family staying for the season.

Key snap off inside the front door lock this morning and now we can't open that door from either side. Back door still lock fine but it the only way in and out now. My husband got diabetes and we got a two year old, so we need the front door working again soon.

The remote for the bedroom air con broke so we can only turn it on and off at the unit, can't change the setting. It still cooling ok. My partner got diabetes and we got a two year old son. When you send someone out on the next trip can they bring new remote.
Roof sheet lifted over the kids' room, rain coming in on the beds. House already gets very hot by the afternoon and now they can't sleep in there. Crew has to come by barge or plane.

Since the weekend the shower drain has been really slow and water sits around our ankles before it goes down. The shower still works and it hasn't come out onto the floor. Tenant reports the kitchen tap has broken inside and no water comes out at the kitchen sink at all, so she is carrying water from the bathroom to cook and make bottles. Eight people live in the three-bedroom house, including two infants. Bathroom taps and toilet still working.

The air con stopped working two days ago and now none of the units blow anything at all. The road out here closes when the rain gets heavy, so please send someone before that.
No power in kitchen or bedroom since last night, fridge off. Rest of the house ok, nothing burning or smelling.

Tenant is deaf and asked me to pass this on: no water has come from any tap or the toilet since yesterday morning. He is living on his own and is buying bottled water from the store. Road in can close in the wet, so the tenant asks that a plumber come out while it is still open.

Tenant says the shower and bathroom sink have been draining very slowly for about a week and the water sits there before it goes down. The back screen door hinge is broke and the door is dragging on the ground now. Still can close and lock the main door behind it, no problem with that. We got seven people living in this house so that door is getting used all day and it getting worse. Please send someone to fix it when they can.

No rush, I know the road out here can close when the wet comes, but could someone check it on the next trip.

Tenant says the kitchen tap has been dripping constantly since he moved in last month and the washer seems worn. He reports everything else in the house is working and he has plenty of water. He asked for it to be added to the next visit and knows the road in can be cut during the wet.

Roof got a hole in it over the kids room after the storm and the rain come in every time now. We put buckets but the room still getting wet so all the kids sleeping in the lounge with us.
